content.short: Phoenix is a high-performance, fully on-chain CLOB DEX on Solana providing CEX-like speed and instant finality.
content.description:
Phoenix is a leading decentralized exchange built natively on the Solana blockchain, utilizing a fully on-chain Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) to provide a professional-grade trading experience. Developed by Ellipsis Labs, the platform features a unique "crankless" design that eliminates the need for external bots to settle trades, resulting in near-instant finality and deep liquidity for spot assets. This ensures that users can trade with the speed and precision typically found only on centralized exchanges.

By leveraging Solana's high throughput and sub-second execution, Phoenix provides a transparent and non-custodial venue for asset exchange that prioritizes user sovereignty. The platform is designed for both retail and institutional participants who require high-frequency execution and institutional-grade risk management on-chain. As a core infrastructure component of the Solana DeFi ecosystem, Phoenix is dedicated to empowering participants with the innovative financial tools needed for sophisticated decentralized trading.
content.meta: Phoenix offers professional-grade on-chain order book trading and instant settlement on the Solana blockchain.
